name: Cenomi Centers (Arabian Centres Company)
note: Listed on the Saudi Exchange (Tadawul). Per the 2025 annual report: immediate parent FAS Real Estate Company Limited (26.89% of capital at 31 December 2025, the largest stake in the substantial-shareholdings table; the next holder holds 4.00%) and ultimate parent Saudi FAS Holding Company; the report names Mr. Fawaz Abdulaziz Al Hokair, Eng. Salman Abdulaziz Al Hokair and Mr. Abdulmajid Abdulaziz Al Hokair as the ultimate joint controlling shareholders, and its board biographies describe Fawaz Abdulaziz Al Hokair, the chairman of the board, as chairman of both Arabian Centres Company and Saudi FAS Holding Company.
